title: ChannelProfile
description: What one messenger can carry. A profile is data (apps/api/channel-profiles/<channel>.yaml); no code branches on a channel name to decide a limit.

channel.description: Must equal the file stem and the Channel value in the code.

description.description: One sentence: which API this profile describes.

max_text_chars.description: Longest text one message may carry. Never above the domain cap, so a scenario step is renderable everywhere.

callback_payload_bytes.description: Longest button id a callback may carry. A scenario button id must fit every enabled profile.

keyboard_scope.description: message: the keyboard belongs to one message (MAX, Telegram). dialog: the keyboard persists for the conversation (VK).

supports_edit.description: Whether a sent message can be rewritten in place; used by the cabinet reply flow.

markup.description: The dialect the renderer must escape the domain text into. Domain text is never written in a channel dialect.

messages_per_second.description: Global pacing for one bot on this channel.

per_chat_per_second.description: Pacing inside one conversation, or null when the channel has no such rule.
